name: prisma-client-api
description: Prisma Client Best Practices - Efficient queries, type safety, connection management, and query optimization
author: prisma

rules.title: Use Prisma Client singleton pattern
rules.description: In development, cache Prisma Client instance on globalThis to prevent multiple connections during hot reloads.

rules.title: Always select only needed fields
rules.description: Never fetch entire records with select: {} or include: {}. Specify exactly which fields are needed to reduce payload and improve performance.

rules.title: Use include for relational data, not manual queries
rules.description: Use Prisma's include to fetch related records in a single query instead of making separate queries in loops (N+1 problem).

rules.title: Use $transaction for multiple writes
rules.description: Wrap multiple related database writes in a $transaction to ensure atomicity and consistency.

rules.title: Implement pagination for large datasets
rules.description: Always use take and skip (or cursor-based pagination) for queries that may return many records. Never fetch unlimited records.

rules.title: Handle Prisma errors explicitly
rules.description: Catch PrismaClientKnownRequestError and check error codes (P2002, P2025, etc.) instead of generic error handling.

rules.title: Avoid raw SQL queries
rules.description: Prefer Prisma Client's type-safe API over $queryRaw. Only use raw queries for complex aggregations that Prisma cannot express.

rules.title: Configure connection pool limits
rules.description: Set connection_limit in DATABASE_URL or Prisma Client configuration to avoid exhausting database connections in serverless environments.
